# hivelocity_maintenance_events (Data Source)

Lists scheduled maintenance events affecting your devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_maintenance_events" "upcoming" {}

output "affected_devices" {
  value = distinct(flatten(data.hivelocity_maintenance_events.upcoming.events[*].device_ids))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `events` (List of Object) Maintenance events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
